chapter_seo_title: Mortal Stream Tactics: Han Li's Bluff against the Mo Estate's Paralysis Incense
chapter_meta_description: Han Li drops the nice act and shows his power, but the Mo widows have their own tricks. A masterclass in social bluffing and deadly paranoia in A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality.
og_title: Han Li’s Social Bluff: The Power of a Confident Grin
og_description: After failing to trick his way to the cure, Han Li threatens the entire Mo Estate. But these widows know about cultivators and have a secret weapon: paralysis incense. Can Han Li bluff his way to victory?
twitter_title: When your plan ‘A’ fails, just threaten to burn the whole house down.
twitter_description: Han Li reveals his cultivation to the Mo widows, only to discover they’ve been playing their own game! A tense chapter of threats, power displays, and deadly paranoia.
